label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

README.md mentions MinIO in running locally steps 2 and requirements, but lacks instructions to set S3_ENDPOINT for MinIO. We should add instruction to set S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 (and create the bucket) in the local setup instructions for MinIO in README.md.
